clips.title: The story
paras: In southwestern Darkshore, the Master's Glaive rises from an ancient, unsettling site. Night elves once revered it as a sacred mystery, but Twilight's Hammer cultists now swarm around the colossal weapon, drawn by the malevolence that lingers there.

At the Master's Glaive, an adamantine blade pierces a colossal petrified skull. No record names the creature or the hand that drove the blade home. Onu, the Ancient of Lore, says only that an old, old lord of the earth fell here. Night elves long believed that only the titans could wield a weapon so vast. The blade and skull remain a monument to that forgotten clash.

Night elves held the Master's Glaive in solemn reverence for generations. Now Twilight's Hammer fanatics have camped around the sunken carcass, digging trenches and uncovering petrified ribs. Whispers beneath the stone draw them to study the remains obsessively and commune with the malevolent power that clings to them. They seek to revive or harness whatever fell essence sleeps within the earth.
